name: db-native-ghost-gate
cmd: set -euo pipefail; cp --remove-destination seed-audit-models/p3.ts research/protocols/ic3syn/seed-audit-p3-models.ts; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; set +e; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.native-ghost.json > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/types.log" 2>&1; T=$?; bun test --timeout 120000 research/bapa/native-ghost-seeds.test.ts research/bapa/native-ghost-public.test.ts research/bapa/witness-value-proxies.test.ts research/bapa/candidate-seed-witness.test.ts research/bapa/existential-seed.test.ts research/bapa/candidate-seed.test.ts research/bapa/counted-seed.test.ts research/bapa/sum-seed.test.ts research/bapa/native-tuple-seed.test.ts research/bapa/proof-worker.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/tests.log" 2>&1; U=$?; bun research/bapa/candidate-seed-audit.ts research/bapa/seed-audit-db.json > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/audit.log" 2>&1; A=$?; bun research/bapa/assert-db-witness-audit.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/witness-audit.log" 2>&1; W=$?; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < seed-audit-models/db-ghost-message.txt > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commitlint.log" 2>&1; L=$?; printf 'types=%s tests=%s audit=%s witness=%s lint=%s\n' "$T" "$U" "$A" "$W" "$L" > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/checks.txt"; test "$T$U$A$W$L" = 00000
